objective: Create ONE original complete cartoon animal RGBA PNG candidate, occupying square 2x2 grid (4 cells), reused as B/D two independent entire animals in approved first 5x4 level, to complement A/C two existing whole approved pandas.

species_features: recognizable animal species even when reduced to board-cell display
one complete head/body/limbs/tail, not fragmented or tiled
humorous expressive face, dark bold contour, clear flat cartoon color masses
compact expressive pose fitting square-shaped overall visual footprint
asset_request.abstraction_brief: Freedom to choose species, face expression and compressed/curled/rounded pose, do not obey real anatomy or three-dimensional foot-contact projection. Form must look like one continuous animal and be readable at about a 2x2 board cell display.
asset_request.pose_view_brief: No forced global camera angle; choose one 2D view fitting 2x2 logical footprint. Distinct from approved original panda species and visual identity.
asset_request.silhouette_brief: Logically all four cells occupied. Animal need not physically fill four rectangle corners, but major mass should make occupancy intuitive; avoid large invisible logical regions, heavy protrusion into neighboring future placed animals and visual orientation ambiguities after rotation. G3 includes all four rotations.
asset_request.render_profile: PNG RGBA single isolated sprite (no environment, stage, built-in chess/grid, outlines of logical cells, texts, collage or UI)
asset_request.source_rights: Original, with generation tool/version, provenance, rights documentation; no reference game's sprite copying.

preserve: Original chapter background src assets/backgrounds/chapter_one.png never edited
Existing user-approved panda src assets/animals/panda_rect6_desktop_001.png SHA256 e88018fb1b8d992834f11ca25303161f28ce2643db6deefe1555c03f54311732 remains untouched
The two pandas A/C are separate full copies; B/D also each full image, NEVER two half-animals or body-part tiles

blocked_on_visual.need: Record exact approved ear-against-body candidate version, original PNG file name/path, original bytes SHA256, PNG dimension/alpha/provenance where genuinely accessible, and whether bytes are in Codex-readable approved local asset folder. If not accessible, label transfer missing. Do not fake paths or hashes.

deliverables: Handoff existing approved candidate only, with exact version/species/file identity and genuine source PNG bytes path + sha256 if actually available
Confirm whole animal, clean alpha, 2x2 footprint, no revisions after approval
GitHub text handoff tasks/FIRST_LEVEL_CONTENT_001/handoff_art_to_design.json; do not assume art-page /mnt/data exists in Codex environment

acceptance: Clearly one whole animal (FAIL_ANIMAL_FRAGMENTATION is hard fail), not a collage or four independent squares
Looks distinct from panda with recognizable species and humorous 2D cartoon quality
Graphic visually fits a roughly square 2x2 footprint; judge sprite at actual target size next to approved panda
When repeated twice, remains visually clear as two independent whole animals, not more than two
No other new animal or changing shape/board/approved asset without explicit design change
